passage:
Every summer, the City Science Museum holds a Night at the Museum event for students aged twelve to fifteen. Students arrive at 6:00 p.m. and leave at 8:00 a.m. the next morning.
During the event, students join three activities. First, they follow a guide through the dinosaur hall with flashlights. Then they build a small paper bridge and test how much weight it can hold. Before sleeping, they watch a short movie about stars on the museum ceiling.
Students must bring a sleeping bag, a water bottle, and a jacket. Snacks will be prepared by the museum. Phones may be used only during the first and last thirty minutes of the event.
The museum says the event is not a party. It is a chance to learn in a different way. At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
